# anthropic_plugin_marketplace (Resource)

Adopts an organization's plugin marketplace through the Plugins API beta `ce-plugins-2026-09-01`, to manage its default installation setting.

Marketplaces are created, connected to a repository and deleted only in
claude.ai, so this resource is import-only: run
`terraform import anthropic_plugin_marketplace.<name> marketplace_...`
to bring one under management. A plain `resource "anthropic_plugin_marketplace"`
block applied without an import fails, because there is nothing to create.
Destroying this resource only stops managing the marketplace and leaves it and
its default unchanged.

The default applies to every plugin in the marketplace that has no
organization-wide setting of its own, including plugins added later. Once a
marketplace has a default it keeps one: it can be changed but never removed,
so removing `default_installation_preference` from the configuration
leaves the current value in place. A member's personal marketplace returns
`403` on update.

The Plugins API is available only to Claude Enterprise organizations. It
accepts an API key created in claude.ai under Organization settings > API
(`sk-ant-api01-...`) with the `read:plugins` and `write:plugins`
scopes, not an Admin API key.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "anthropic_plugin_marketplace" "engineering_tools" {
  provider                        = anthropic.plugins
  default_installation_preference = "available"
}

import {
  provider = anthropic.plugins
  to       = anthropic_plugin_marketplace.engineering_tools
  id       = "marketplace_01VbNcMxZaSdFgHjKlQwErTy"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `default_installation_preference` (String) Default installation setting for plugins in this marketplace: `required`, `auto_install`, `available` or `not_available`. A marketplace whose default was never set reports `not_available`. Leave unset to keep whatever default the marketplace already has. The API validates the value, so a value it adds later works without a provider release.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp of when the marketplace was created.
- `id` (String) The unique ID of this resource.
- `last_sync_ended_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp of when the last synchronization ended. Null when the marketplace has none.
- `last_sync_read_sha` (String) Commit the last synchronization read. Null when the marketplace has none.
- `name` (String) Name of the marketplace.
- `owner` (Attributes) Who owns the marketplace: the organization, or the member whose personal marketplace it is. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--owner))
- `source` (String) Where the marketplace's plugins come from: `directory`, `github`, `gitlab`, `manual` or `public_git`.
- `sync_status` (String) Result of the last synchronization, for example `success`, `in_progress` or `failed_auth`. Null for a `manual` marketplace.

<a id="nestedatt--owner"></a>
### Nested Schema for `owner`

Read-Only:

- `type` (String) Owner type: `organization` or `user`.
- `user_id` (String) ID of the member who owns the marketplace. Null unless `type` is `user`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import anthropic_plugin_marketplace.engineering_tools marketplace_01VbNcMxZaSdFgHjKlQwErTy
```
